name: Geo Milev
bio: Geo Milev (born Georgi Milev Kasabov, 1895-1925) was a Bulgarian poet, translator and editor, a leading voice of Bulgarian expressionism. He studied in Leipzig and London and translated Verhaeren, Whitman and Poe, among others, and edited the journal Plamak.

His long poem Septemvri (1924), on the suppressed uprising of September 1923, led to a prosecution for obscenity and blasphemy. In May 1925 he was arrested and disappeared; his remains were found in a mass grave in 1989.
